verdict.rationale: Xero is an accounting SaaS with a public API, SDKs and an MCP server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, demo company or isolated test environment that keeps tests away from production data. The API, SDK, Custom Connections and MCP server items describe access to live organisations, not isolated testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
